verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no SOC 2 attestation, trust center, data-handling or retention policy, or datacenter tier/certification information for Paperspace. Mentions of datacenter regions, private networks, and team-scoped API keys are adjacent operational features, not a verifiable security and compliance posture.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify the provider's security and compliance posture (SOC 2, data handling, datacenter tiers) before putting proprietary models on it
